# P-002 - Notes vertical capability
<!-- phase: P-002 -->

<!-- section: P-002.objective -->
<a id="p-002-objective"></a>
## objective
Deliver coherent create, replace, read and delete behavior over isolated in-memory stores.
<!-- /section: P-002.objective -->

<!-- section: P-002.scope -->
<a id="p-002-scope"></a>
## scope
Implement NoteStore only, preserving the existing identifier contract. Requirements: G-001, R-ID, R-NOTE. No database or web UI.
<!-- /section: P-002.scope -->

<!-- section: P-002.contracts -->
<a id="p-002-contracts"></a>
## contracts
Consume the CLOSED P-001 C-NOTE-ID implementation. Validate id before data access. Consumers observe KeyError for absent valid ids and ValueError for invalid inputs; invalid requests never mutate state.
<!-- /section: P-002.contracts -->

<!-- section: P-002.implementation -->
<a id="p-002-implementation"></a>
## implementation
Inspect P-001 handover and actual validate_id implementation. Extend noteapp.py with the store, reuse validation, preserve independent instances and deterministic failures. Tester owns test_notes.py. The feature and its failure behavior form one deliverable.
<!-- /section: P-002.implementation -->

<!-- section: P-002.verification -->
<a id="p-002-verification"></a>
## verification
Tester runs notes tests for create, overwrite, get, delete, absent ids, invalid input, no mutation on failure, and isolated stores; rerun the identifier suite for regression.
<!-- /section: P-002.verification -->

<!-- section: P-002.acceptance -->
<a id="p-002-acceptance"></a>
## acceptance
All mapped requirements pass. Existing identifiers retain their contract. A failed operation changes no note. Both suites execute nonzero tests, and Reviewer independently checks code and evidence.
<!-- /section: P-002.acceptance -->

<!-- section: P-002.handover -->
<a id="p-002-handover"></a>
## handover
Publish NoteStore method signatures, real source/test paths, verification command receipts and exceptions. Record the intentionally in-memory lifetime.
<!-- /section: P-002.handover -->

## Cross-phase reference
The reader includes the generated exact-source context. Reference does not import another phase's implementation tasks.
